doc.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau and Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1957-09-01

title: Previous owners of the banjo, instruction books and reading music
summary: Frank Myers owned the banjo before; they look at Morris and McNeil method books, and Marrero says he plays mostly by ear and reads some.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
